description: Public page: PublicSiteController@home loads all 7 groups from MySQL and shapes them into the exact arrays the untouched JS modules expect; home.blade.php ports index.html verbatim (asset refs rewritten, head order + 13-script body order preserved); partials/app-data.blade.php emits the inline window.App.* = @json(...) bootstrap that replaces js/data.js (design B.6). Depends on FEAT-002 (models + seed data). Delivers AC #1-#4.
steps: Create app/Http/Controllers/PublicSiteController.php with a home() method. Query every group ordered by sort_order then id (design B.11): CARS mapped to ['id','model','type','category','year'=>(int),'price'=>(int),'transmission','fuel','seats'=>(int),'badge'=>$c->badge ?? '','accent'=>[$c->accent1,$c->accent2],'img'] with NO desc key; CAT_STYLE built as a PHP ASSOCIATIVE array `CategoryStyle::all()->keyBy('category')->map(fn($s)=>['bg'=>$s->bg,'label'=>$s->label])->toArray()` — never call ->values() (would emit a JS array and break CAT_STYLE[car.category]); QUIZ nested via QuizQuestion::with('options.scores')->orderBy('sort_order') mapped to [{q,icon,options:[{t,icon,score: scores->pluck('points','car_model')}]}] with score an OBJECT map; WHEEL_PRIZES [label,short,color,weight,msg] (short keeps real \n); CORNER_IMAGES [src,alt]; HERO_SLIDES [name,desc=>description,tag,price,img]; TESTIMONIALS [name,city,car,rating=>(int),color,img,text]. Pass all seven to the view.
Register GET / -> PublicSiteController@home as name 'home' in routes/web.php (replace the default welcome route).

Create resources/views/home.blade.php from d:\DATA - AHMAD\Project\kuya\index.html: port the markup verbatim; rewrite href/src asset refs to {{ asset('css/style.css') }}, {{ asset('js/xxx.js') }}, image refs. Keep the HEAD order EXACTLY: <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script> then <script src="{{ asset('js/tailwind.config.js') }}"></script> then <link ... css/style.css> (tailwind.config.js is a HEAD script, NOT a body module).

In the body-bottom block keep the 13-script order 1:1 but replace ONLY the first entry <script src="js/data.js"></script> with @include('partials.app-data'); wrap the remaining 12 (utils, ui, hero-slider, catalog, compare, car-detail, quiz, testimonials, calculator, corner-widget, spin-wheel, main) in {{ asset('js/xxx.js') }} with order unchanged.

Create resources/views/partials/app-data.blade.php emitting exactly: <script> window.App = window.App || {}; App.CARS=@json($cars); App.CAT_STYLE=@json($catStyle); App.QUIZ=@json($quiz); App.WHEEL_PRIZES=@json($wheelPrizes); App.CORNER_IMAGES=@json($cornerImages); App.HERO_SLIDES=@json($heroSlides); App.TESTIMONIALS=@json($testimonials); </script>

Add a feature test (design B.16): GET / returns 200, body contains `App.CARS = [` with 9 car entries, contains `App.CAT_STYLE = {` and does NOT contain `App.CAT_STYLE = [`, and App.QUIZ has 4 questions.
acceptance_criteria: GET / returns HTTP 200 and renders the full landing page (hero slider, car grid+filters, quiz, testimonials, spin wheel, corner widget) with data from MySQL, visually identical to the original static site (AC #1).
The rendered body contains `App.CARS = [` with 9 entries, each with keys id/model/type/category/year/price/transmission/fuel/seats/badge/accent/img where accent is a 2-element array (AC #2).
The rendered body contains `App.CAT_STYLE = {` (object) and NOT `App.CAT_STYLE = [` (array) (AC #3, B.16 regression guard).
App.QUIZ is 4 question objects with 14 options total and object-map score fields (AC #4).
The head loads cdn.tailwindcss.com then js/tailwind.config.js then css/style.css in that order; the 13-script body order is preserved with data.js replaced by the @include.
verification: php artisan test --filter=Public (the GET / shape + CAT_STYLE object-not-array feature test passes)
Start `php artisan serve`; GET http://127.0.0.1:8000/ returns 200 and the body contains `App.CARS = [` and `App.CAT_STYLE = {`
Manually load / in a browser and confirm the page renders identically to index.html with no console errors
findings: Controller: app/Http/Controllers/PublicSiteController.php@home shapes all 7 groups. CARS/QUIZ/WHEEL_PRIZES/CORNER_IMAGES/HERO_SLIDES/TESTIMONIALS ordered by sort_order then id; accent emitted as [accent1, accent2], badge NULL->'', NO desc key. CAT_STYLE: category_styles has NO sort_order column (per design B.11 keyed-map exemption), so used CategoryStyle::all()->keyBy('category')->map(fn($s)=>['bg'=>,'label'=>])->toArray() (NEVER ->values()) -> @json emits a JS object literal. QUIZ via QuizQuestion::with(['options.scores']) with score=$o->scores->pluck('points','car_model') object map. HERO_SLIDES maps DB column description -> JS key desc. Route: GET / -> PublicSiteController@home name 'home' in routes/web.php (replaced the default welcome closure). View: resources/views/home.blade.php ported from index.html verbatim; head order preserved (cdn.tailwindcss.com, then {{ asset('js/tailwind.config.js') }}, then {{ asset('css/style.css') }}); 13-script body order preserved 1:1 with the data.js slot replaced by @include('partials.app-data') and the remaining 12 wrapped in {{ asset('js/*.js') }}. Partial: resources/views/partials/app-data.blade.php emits window.App.* = @json(...) for all 7 groups (format 'App.CARS = @json(...)' so output is 'App.CARS = ['). Test: tests/Feature/PublicSiteTest.php (RefreshDatabase + DatabaseSeeder; asserts GET / 200, 'App.CARS = [' with 9 "model": entries, 'App.CAT_STYLE = {' present and 'App.CAT_STYLE = [' absent, 'App.QUIZ = [' with 4 "q": entries). Verified: php artisan test --filter=Public PASS (1 passed, 7 assertions); live php artisan serve GET / returned 200 with CARS[=true, CAT_STYLE{=true, CAT_STYLE[=false, 9 models, tailwind.config asset present, app-data bootstrap before utils.js.
